record.notes: Projects on paid plans are not paused for inactivity, so the smallest paid step removes the Free plan's 1-week inactivity pause. That step is Pro, from USD 25 a month: a single database-only project on Micro compute costs USD 25 a month before usage beyond the included quotas, and additional projects add their full compute cost. Pro includes an 8 GB disk per project (then USD 0.125 per GB), 250 GB egress (then USD 0.09 per GB), 250 GB cached egress (then USD 0.03 per GB), 100 GB file storage (then USD 0.0213 per GB) and 100,000 monthly active users (then USD 0.00325 per MAU), plus daily backups stored for 7 days, 7-day log retention and email support. A USD 10 a month compute credit covers one Micro instance, and spend caps are on by default.

card.summary: 1 GB file storage. PER ORGANIZATION, not per project; 5 GB egress + 5 GB cached egress per org; 2 free projects per user (across all orgs).

free_tier.stated: 1 GB file storage. PER ORGANIZATION, not per project; 5 GB egress + 5 GB cached egress per org; 2 free projects per user (across all orgs).

retention.stated: 50 MB max file size on Free (global limit, cannot raise); 1 GB storage/org; projects paused after 7 days inactivity and must be manually restored; storage metered in GB-Hours so deleting late in the month barely helps; 5 GB egress hard-capped (overage not purchasable on Free).

egress.terms: 5 GB uncached + 5 GB cached egress per org per month, unified across Database/Auth/Storage. Storage has its own Smart CDN so cache hits consume the cached bucket. THIS IS THE WALL: 1 GB stored can be served only 5x/month before the org is restricted.

record.tooling: Storage is S3-compatible (supabase storage S3 endpoint, aws CLI / boto3 / rclone `s3` remote with endpoint override), plus supabase-js and the REST storage API
record.chaining: The premise '100 projects per free org' is WRONG on two counts: (a) quota is per ORGANIZATION not per project. 'The quota is applied to your entire organization, independent of how many projects you launch'; (b) the free project limit is TWO, and it is account-wide: 'You are granted two free projects. The project limit applies across all organizations where you are an Owner or Administrator.. two Free Plan organizations with one project each, or one Free Plan organization with two projects.' So the ceiling is 2 projects x but only 1 GB + 5 GB egress TOTAL. Paused projects do not count toward the limit, so pause/unpause rotation is the only lever, and it is manual.
record.limits_note: 50 MB max file size on Free (global limit, cannot raise); 1 GB storage/org; projects paused after 7 days inactivity and must be manually restored; storage metered in GB-Hours so deleting late in the month barely helps; 5 GB egress hard-capped (overage not purchasable on Free).
record.reliability_note: Free projects pause after 1 week of inactivity. Data persists but the project is offline until manually restored from the dashboard. Egress overage leads to a grace period then restriction until the next billing cycle.
